message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-11-09 13:10 IST to 2026-11-10 13:10 IST (2026-11-09 07:40 to 2026-11-10 07:40 UTC)  
**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only; component names and obvious aliases were normalized and duplicates removed. The primary product lists were not used.

No newly reported or materially updated vulnerability was verified in the last 24 hours as relevant to the monitored DLL/software components. Recent advisory results in the window concerned unrelated products, and component-related results found during the scan were published before the cutoff.

### Findings

No qualifying findings.

### MongoDB ecosystem sweep

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise), mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm and App Services, official integrations, and major officially maintained libraries and services. Checks included MongoDB's official alerts, public CVE and GitHub advisory records, CISA sources, and searches for MongoDB-owned advisories whose titles might omit the vendor name.

No MongoDB-related vulnerability was verified as newly reported or materially updated inside the scan window. MongoDB's newest product alert visible during this run was dated 2026-11-06 and was therefore excluded as stale.

**Sources checked:** [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories?query=published%3A2026-11-09..2026-11-10), [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)

**Closing:** No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this 24-hour scan. Continue routine monitoring; older known issues in deployed component versions were outside this digest's freshness scope.
